ChatGPT gets image ads
Who sees them

lines.text: Free ChatGPT is about to get picture ads.
lines.say: Free ChatGPT is about to get picture ads.

lines.text: Mon, Oct 5, 2026: OpenAI said visual ads will appear next to ChatGPT image results, starting with a US test later in October.
lines.say: On Monday, OpenAI said picture ads will show up next to images ChatGPT makes, starting with a US test later in October.

scene.headline: ChatGPT adds ads to image results

lines.text: Ads show only on Free and Go ($8/month). Plus ($20/month) and higher plans have no ads.
lines.say: Only the free plan and the eight-dollar Go plan get ads. Plus, at twenty dollars a month, and higher plans don't.
Why? Reach. ChatGPT went from one hundred million weekly users in late twenty twenty-three to one point two billion in September.

lines.text: Text ads began testing Feb 9, 2026. By Aug 31 they hit a $1 billion annualized run rate (one month of sales x 12).
lines.say: And ads already pay. Text ads started in February and hit a one billion dollar annual run rate by the end of August.

lines.text: OpenAI says ads are labeled, don't change ChatGPT's answers, and advertisers don't see your chats.
lines.say: OpenAI says the ads are labeled, don't change ChatGPT's answers, and advertisers don't see your chats.

lines.text: Ad-free options: opt out on Free (fewer messages), or Plus at $20/month = $240 a year.
lines.say: Free users can opt out for fewer messages, or pay twenty dollars a month for Plus, two hundred forty a year.

lines.text: That's the money. Follow for more.

Oct 5, 2026: OpenAI said visual ads will appear next to ChatGPT image results, starting with a US test later in October.

ChatGPT reaches 1.2 billion weekly users (Sep 2026), and its ads hit a $1 billion annualized run rate by Aug 31, 2026.
Sources: OpenAI, TechCrunch, Axios, Digiday.
